title: Effect of MicroRNA-4713-3p on Promoting Malignant Progression of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma via Targeted Inhibition of EPHX3 to Activate Wnt/beta-Catenin Signaling Pathway.
authors: Hong, Qichao; Liu, Shuzhou; Zhang, Qimeng; Ding, Shun; Xing, Chengliang; Yan, Jingren; Zhang, Liuyang; Mu, Zhonglin
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究miR-4713-3p靶向抑制EPHX3激活Wnt/β-catenin通路促进鼻咽癌进展，虽涉及分子对接但核心为miRNA-基因调控与肿瘤表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) represents a common malignancy in the head-and-neck region, and its development and prognosis can be influenced by multiple factors. Epoxide hydrolase 3 (EPHX3) is an enzyme that perform crucial roles in inflammation and tumors regulation. We aim to discuss the expression pattern and biological function of EPHX3 in NPC. The EPHX3 expression patterns in NPC tissues and cell lines were determined by the qRT-PCR technique. Correlations between EPHX3 expression and the clinical characteristics of NPC patients were subsequently assessed. Afterwards, the mechanism of miR-4713 targeting EPHX3 in NPC was validated either in vitro or in vivo. Gene set enrichment analysis and cell experiments were conducted to prove the impact of the EPHX3-regulated downstream Wnt/beta-catenin pathway on the progression of NPC and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). EPHX3 mRNA expression was significantly downregulated in NPC tissues compared with adjacent normal tissues (p < 0.01). Overexpression of miR-4713-3p markedly enhanced cell proliferation (p < 0.05), migration, and invasion, while dual-luciferase and molecular docking confirmed that EPHX3 is a direct target of miR-4713-3p. Mechanistically, key components of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, including beta-catenin and c-Myc, were significantly upregulated following miR-4713-3p overexpression (p < 0.01), whereas EPHX3 overexpression suppressed these changes and inhibited EMT. In vivo, miR-4713-3p knockdown suppressed tumor growth in xenograft models (p < 0.05). Our study reveals the significance of EPHX3 in the development of NPC and offers a basis for the promise of EPHX3 as a possible therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 鼻咽癌（NPC）是头颈部常见的恶性肿瘤，其发生发展和预后受多种因素影响。环氧化物水解酶3（EPHX3）是一种在炎症和肿瘤调控中发挥关键作用的酶。我们旨在探讨EPHX3在NPC中的表达模式及其生物学功能。通过qRT-PCR技术检测了NPC组织和细胞系中EPHX3的表达模式，随后评估了EPHX3表达与NPC患者临床特征之间的相关性。之后，在体外和体内验证了miR-4713靶向EPHX3在NPC中的机制。通过基因集富集分析和细胞实验，证明了EPHX3调控的下游Wnt/β-catenin通路对NPC进展及上皮-间质转化（EMT）的影响。与相邻正常组织相比，NPC组织中EPHX3 mRNA表达显著下调（p < 0.01）。miR-4713-3p的过表达显著增强了细胞增殖（p < 0.05）、迁移和侵袭，而双荧光素酶实验和分子对接证实EPHX3是miR-4713-3p的直接靶标。机制上，Wnt/β-catenin通路的关键组分，包括β-catenin和c-Myc，在miR-4713-3p过表达后显著上调（p < 0.01），而EPHX3过表达则抑制了这些变化并阻碍了EMT。在体内，miR-4713-3p敲低抑制了异种移植模型中的肿瘤生长（p < 0.05）。我们的研究揭示了EPHX3在NPC发展中的重要性，并为EPHX3作为潜在治疗靶点的前景提供了依据。
